## vMLX 1.6.20 for macOS

This Electron/Python checkpoint is built from source commit `7022a7d845ff2b1ee458d45a8ebd98f6fc501d9e`.

### Highlights

- DeepSeek V4 Flash reasoning, DSML tools, sampling guidance, cache pooling, context admission, and stop handling are hardened.
- Cache reporting now separates live-process activity from persistent storage and improves partial-tail, SSD-only, RAM eviction, and disk-refault behavior.
- Electron settings expose effective DSV4 runtime state and warn when top-p differs from bundle guidance.
- The bundled runtime uses JANG 2.5.39.

Separate signed and Apple-notarized Apple-silicon downloads are available for macOS Tahoe and Sequoia-compatible systems. Tahoe is the default download. This focused checkpoint does not imply exhaustive certification of every model family or maximum-context configuration.
